why: Grades screen.dashboard.error: tracing the catch path in dashboard.jsx shows the error state can never render.

finding.title: Dashboard catch handler never clears isLoading, pinning the screen in a permanent skeleton on error
finding.detail: In src/screens/dashboard.jsx:15-20, .catch() calls setError(...) without calling setIsLoading(false). Because if (isLoading) at line 23 precedes if (error) at line 27, a failed fetchSummary() leaves the skeleton mounted forever and the error banner is unreachable.
finding.recommendation: Call setIsLoading(false) inside the .catch() block at src/screens/dashboard.jsx:18 (or in a .finally() handler) and add a Retry button to the error-banner at line 27.

why: Grades screen.results: cross-checking survey.jsx against results.jsx exposes an N=1 anonymity breach.

finding.title: Results unlock at completedCount >= 1, exposing the first respondent's private answers as the company average
finding.detail: SurveyScreen (src/screens/survey.jsx:9-13) promises participants that leadership only sees a combined reading once at least 3 teammates respond. ResultsScreen (src/screens/results.jsx:8-14) gates on campaign.completedCount < 1 and says "Results unlock as soon as one person completes a checkup", so at N=1 the aggregate score is the first respondent's exact answers.
finding.recommendation: Export MIN_RESPONDENTS = 3 and gate ResultsScreen at src/screens/results.jsx:8 on campaign.completedCount < MIN_RESPONDENTS, updating the empty-state copy at line 11 to match survey.jsx.
